not_executed_by_rule.rule: executed_prefix_len = cap when served_output_len == cap (length stop); served_output_len + LAG when the request stopped by EOS before its cap (the last served token must be a declared EOS id, F-pm-24, and it must be the FIRST EOS served -- tokens served after an EOS are served past the stop, F-r17-14); LAG = the workload Program's declared static (R17-1), never read from the trace; positions >= executed_prefix_len are programmed-but-unexecuted (not required; committed = execution past the stop)
not_executed_by_rule.scope: NOT-EXECUTED-BY-RULE is an active-reference implementation classification only. In the lifted fixed Program the corresponding positions are REQUIRED logical values assigned the canonical inactive representation tau(e) = bot; there is no not-required-because-not-executed category. (COORD R17-27)

query.unit: Program row = module-boundary VU under Q_module_v1: identities are the module output members per (request, step, module) + ids, sampled ids, weights, the attention M1 stream; Q_fine_v1 (vu_canonical) selects the required families (query_digest) and is not the implemented population unit (R17-9 (ii), F-r17b-05, R17-10)

why.fa2_hidden_m1_stream: the attention override refines AttentionHead into AttnBlock interiors (s[c] dots, PV k-step chains, max chain, Fa2InvSum) -> the M1 export stream of every attention launch (layer x step) is required
why.input_token_ids: Embedding_v1 opens on its ids input (Input32)
why.instance_outputs: every VU family of the query (Gemm y[n], norm normalize path, SiluMul, RoPE, Embedding) opens on the producing instance's OUTPUT words -> every Program instance output member per step is required
why.weights: Input16 registered inputs: every weight field the Program's `weights` parameter names
